title: Complaints of Job Discrimination Faced by People with Disabilities
what_it_is: Complaints of Job Discrimination Faced by People with Disabilities

sections.label: TAFEP workplace complaints investigated
sections.summary: TAFEP received about 1,600 workplace complaints in five years, four alleging disability discrimination, and found no evidence of discrimination.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In the past five years, the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) received about 1,600 complaints on workplace issues, of which, four complaints were allegations of discrimination against persons with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Upon investigation, TAFEP found no evidence of discrimination, but that the main reason for such complaints was due to poor communication and lack of sensitivity when working with persons with disabilities.

sections.label: MOM action and anti-discrimination laws
sections.summary: MOM will act against offending companies and curtail work pass privileges, and says there is no conclusive evidence anti-discrimination laws improve employability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM will not hesitate to take actions against offending companies and curtail their work pass privileges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: There is no conclusive evidence that anti-discrimination laws necessarily improve employability of persons with disabilities.

sections.label: Wrongful dismissal claims tribunal
sections.summary: Wrongful dismissal claims will be heard by the Employment Claims Tribunal in April 2019 after the Employment Act is amended.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Wrongful dismissal claims will be heard by the Employment Claims Tribunal in April 2019, after the Employment Act is amended later this year.

sections.label: EMP3 initiatives for employers
sections.summary: EMP3 initiatives include the Workplace Disability Inclusive Index, the Job Placement and Job Support Programme, and the Enabling Employers Award and Inclusive Business Forum.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Initiatives under EMP3 include the Workplace Disability Inclusive Index which is an online assessment tool that helps employers assess their readiness to hire persons with disabilities and to identify areas for improvement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The second one is the Job Placement and Job Support Programme which provides vocational assessment and job-matching in open employment and post-placement support for up to 12 months, and the Bi-annual Enabling Employers Award and Inclusive Business Forum which recognises and propagates progressive employment practices among employers.

sections.label: Employers adopting the Standard
sections.summary: As at end August 2018, about 700 employers with about 375,000 employees have adopted this Standard.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: As at the end of August 2018, about 700 employers with about 375,000 employees have adopted this Standard.
